faq.q: What boats are available for a family boat day with jet ski, snorkel, and paddleboard?
faq.a: We recommend Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, 9 pax; Azimut 39 – 12.5m, 11 pax) from €749/2h. For larger groups, Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) start at €4,719/4h and include a free jet ski. All depart Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Is the jet ski included in the price?
faq.a: For Tier B charters (e.g., Mangusta 80), a jet ski is included free for the duration. For Tier A charters, a jet ski can be added as an extra – please contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. Snorkel gear and paddleboard are included on all charters.

faq.q: What is included in the family boat day package?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Snorkel gear and paddleboard are provided free of charge. Jet ski is included on Tier B boats or available as an add-on.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The boat already includes a selection of beverages and snacks, but you can supplement as you wish. Just let your skipper know if you need a cooler or extra storage space.

faq.q: What is the best time of day for a family boat day in Marbella?
faq.a: Morning departures (9–10am) offer calm seas and cooler temperatures, ideal for snorkelling and paddleboarding. Afternoon trips (1–2pm) give you warm sun and golden light for photos. Sunset charters (5–6pm) are magical but shorter daylight for water activities.

faq.q: How do I book a family boat day with jet ski, snorkel, and paddleboard?
faq.a: You can book directly via our website or by contacting us on WhatsApp. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For Tier B boats or custom combos, we’ll send a personalised quote. A deposit secures your date.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe for jet ski, snorkel, or paddleboard activities, we will reschedule or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will advise you 24–48 hours before departure.

faq.q: Can we combine the boat day with a visit to Cabopino or Estepona?
faq.a: Absolutely. Depending on your charter duration, the skipper can take you to Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or along the coast to Cabopino or Estepona. These spots offer calm waters for snorkelling and paddleboarding, plus scenic views of La Concha mountain.

data.body_html:
Plan a family boat day with jet ski, snorkel, and paddleboard in Marbella 2033 – all from one departure point in Puerto Banús. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, a reunion, or just a sunny weekend, our charters combine three water activities in a single trip. You’ll have a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included, so you can focus on fun. Prices start at €749 for two hours on a Tier A boat (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) and go up to a Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski from €4,719 for four hours. No hidden fees – Spanish IVA (21%) is always included.

Why Choose a Family Boat Day with Jet Ski, Snorkel, and Paddleboard?

A family boat day with jet ski, snorkel, and paddleboard in Marbella 2033 is the ultimate way to explore the Costa del Sol. You get three distinct experiences without the hassle of multiple bookings. The jet ski gives you speed and adrenaline; snorkelling lets you discover marine life in clear coves; paddleboarding offers a calm, full-body workout. All equipment is provided free of charge on your charter. Our boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you’re minutes from the best spots along the Golden Mile, Cabopino, and Estepona.

Our Fleet for Family Boat Day Combos

We operate a range of boats suitable for families. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect – both Tier A boats from €749/2h. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or its grey variant offer space and luxury from €4,719/4h, with a jet ski included free. Other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) are available on request – contact us via WhatsApp for pricing.

What’s Included in Your Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)
  • Snorkel gear and paddleboard (free on all charters)
  • Jet ski (free on Tier B boats; add-on for Tier A)

Suggested Itinerary for Your Family Boat Day

Depart Puerto Banús at 10am. Head west towards Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés – two sheltered coves ideal for snorkelling and paddleboarding. After an hour of water activities, cruise along the coast to Cabopino for a swim stop. Return to port via the Marbella Marina, spotting La Concha mountain in the distance. For longer charters (4–8 hours), extend to Estepona or Sotogrande. Your skipper will tailor the route to your family’s preferences.

Pricing and Booking

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749/2h or €2,299/8h – includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, snorkel gear, and paddleboard. Jet ski add-on available on request. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80): €4,719 minimum 4h – includes a free jet ski. For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Book directly on our website or message us for a custom quote. A 50% deposit secures your date.

Best Spots for Snorkelling and Paddleboarding Near Marbella

The Costa del Sol has several protected coves with calm, clear water. Cala del Faro (near Cabopino) is a shallow sandy bay perfect for beginners. Cala Cortés (east of Marbella) offers rocky outcrops with marine life. Río Verde estuary is a unique spot for paddleboarding among dunes. Your skipper knows the conditions and will choose the safest location based on wind and tide.
